blocks.heading: Fire Prevention – Tips for Preventing Accidental Fires
blocks.body:
[Reference 1910.39 & 1910.106 / 1926.152]

Accidental fires are an unusual occurrence in most workplaces. So it is easy to take for granted some of the everyday hazards that, if overlooked, can contribute to the occurrence of these fires. So here are some general tips to help prevent accidental fires at work, as well as at your home:

Does anybody have a question or comment about these tips for the prevention of fires at work or home? Please be sure to sign your name to the training certification form so you get credit for attending this training session.
